newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices firm ahead of U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices firm ahead of U.S. data.

text.p: Danish bond prices continued to edge up on Tuesday, in quiet trade ahead of U.S. March consumer price data, due at 1230 GMT.
"Activity will most probably be low and and price changes limited until then," a dealer said.
At 0745 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was up 0.27 point to 109.09, yielding 6.61 percent.
The crown traded at 3.8082 per mark,firming slightly from Monday's 3.8092.
The 10-year yield gap with Germany was unchanged at 70 basis points.
The six percent mortgage bond due 2026 gained 0.10 point, to 87.40. --Stig Petersen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33 969659
